title: fix(app-shell): the language menu asks before a switch drops a page's unsaved edits (objectui#13254)
body:
Part of #13254

Clause-②: no

The card's second half, as the seat decision on objectui#13254 ruled it (option A, "ask first"): on a page holding unsaved edits, a language switch asks the page's own question before it switches. Cancel keeps the language and the edits; OK switches. The first half is PR #13259, already landed. Ending the card is the seat's call, after this PR lands.

## What this changes

`LocaleSwitcher` (the globe under the avatar menu's Preferences › Language) now routes each entry through `confirmUnsavedLeave`, the seam objectui#13231 landed, the same way the header's other menu entries do:

```tsx
const pick = (code: string) => confirmUnsavedLeave(() => selectLanguage(code));
// ...
onClick={() => pick(code)}
```

- With no page registered, the switch happens at once, as before.
- `chrome/unsavedEdits.ts`, `useLanguageSelection` and the shell's `MetadataProvider key={language}` remount are not touched.

## The PM's mechanism hypotheses, measured

- **H1, the shape: held.** The promise from `selectLanguage` is returned to the seam, as the header's Log out entry returns `signOut()`. So after OK the tab-close prompt does not ask a second time while the switch loads. A test pins it, and ablation 2 below turns it red with `void`.
- **H2, the checked entry is a no-op: falsified, so it keeps asking.** Unit probe, signed in, real `I18nProvider` and `useLanguageSelection`, never committed. Picking the checked `English` while `en` is active:
  - no remount under a `key={language}` wrapper (mounts 1 to 1);
  - `languageChanged('en')` is emitted, and every reader gets a new `t` (2 identities);
  - `sys_user.locale` is written again: `update('sys_user', 'usr_1', { locale: 'en' })`.
  - So the checked entry asks too. The comment beside the fix says why, and the test's checked-entry case pins it in both directions.
- **H3, the Radix timing: the order differs, and the outcome holds.** Radix runs the item's `onClick` before it closes the menu. In Chromium the question appears while both menus (the avatar menu and the language menu) are still open: 2 open menus at the question. After Cancel:
  - the language menu is closed and the avatar menu stays open;
  - the language is unchanged and no `sys_user` write was sent.
  - On OK the shell remount closes the avatar menu too.

## Measured in Chromium 141

Setup: this branch's console vite dev server on its own port, with `/api/**` stubbed by the first half's census F3 stubs (`zh` offered). The page is a dirty `/apps/crm/system/settings/localization`: Date format changed from `YYYY-MM-DD` to `DD/MM/YYYY`, bar "1 unsaved change". The probe took avatar › Language and picked an entry three times in a row. A wrapper around `window.confirm`, installed by an init script, recorded each question. An expando planted on the input shows whether the page remounted.

| leg | this branch | base (fix reverted, then restored) |
|---|---|---|
| 中文, Cancel | asked "You have unsaved changes. Are you sure you want to leave?"; `en`; `DD/MM/YYYY`; bar "1 unsaved change"; no `sys_user` write; input kept | no question; `zh`; `YYYY-MM-DD`; bar gone; `PATCH /api/v1/data/sys_user/u_admin`; input replaced |
| English (checked), Cancel | asked; `en`; `DD/MM/YYYY`; bar kept; no write; input kept | (the language was already `zh`) no question; switched back to `en`; second PATCH |
| 中文, OK | asked; `zh`; `YYYY-MM-DD`; bar gone; one PATCH; input replaced; no menu open | no question; `zh`; third PATCH |

The base column ran on the same dev server, with the fix line reverted through `ablation-replace.mjs`. The tool reported the blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty after the restore. The probes lived in the session scratchpad and were never committed.

## Tests

New: `packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/LocaleSwitcher.unsavedEditsAsk-13254.test.tsx`. It drives the real `LocaleSwitcher` with the real Radix menu, the real `I18nProvider` and the real `useLanguageSelection`, signed in, over a fake `sys_user` row. The page is a draft input that registers through `useRegisterUnsavedEdits(dirty, message)`, under a `key={language}` that stands in for the shell's remount.

- Another language asks the page's question. Cancel keeps the language, the edit and the column, and closes the menu.
- OK switches to that language and writes it to `sys_user.locale`.
- OK: the tab-close guard does not ask a second time while the switch loads.
- The checked entry asks too. Cancel writes nothing, and OK writes the column again.
- Control: with nothing registered, there is no question and the switch happens at once.

At `bf8a87084`, all through the shared verify lock:
- the new file: `Tests 5 passed (5)`;
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over `packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/`, the seam's `chrome/unsavedEdits-13231.test.tsx`, `hooks/__tests__/userLocale-10059.test.tsx`, `userLocaleOwnerChange-10193.test.tsx`, `sharedInboxFeed.twoSurfaces.test.tsx`, `HomeLayout.searchOpensPalette-12601.test.tsx`, `studio-locale.i18n.test.tsx` and `ResourceEditPage.leaveGuard-13231.test.tsx`: `Test Files 115 passed (115)`, `Tests 779 passed (779)`, exit 0.

Ablation, committed first, through `ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode. Each leg reported the blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty after its restore. The suite imports `../LocaleSwitcher` from source, so there is no dist leg.
1. `onClick={() => pick(code)}` replaced with the base line `onClick={() => void selectLanguage(code)}`. Predicted 4 red and 1 green, and that is what ran: `Tests 4 failed | 1 passed (5)`. The four seam cases went red (no question asked, or the tab-close prompt held); the control stayed green.
2. `confirmUnsavedLeave(() => selectLanguage(code))` replaced with `confirmUnsavedLeave(() => void selectLanguage(code))`. Predicted only the tab-close case red, and that is what ran: `Tests 1 failed | 4 passed (5)`, with "expected true to be false".

## Gates

At `bf8a87084`, hand-derived for objectui, each exit code captured before any pipe:
- `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...' --concurrency=2`: exit 0 (28 tasks), run first because the type-check reads dist.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists both changed source files.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell lint`: exit 0, with 0 errors. The new test has no warnings. `LocaleSwitcher.tsx` keeps its one existing warning (`react-refresh/only-export-components` on `localeLabel`, present at base).
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: exit 0, `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`.
- `pnpm check:control-bytes`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: exit 0. It declares `.changeset/13254-locale-switch-asks.md`, `@object-ui/app-shell` patch.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`: exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- **Other paths to the same remount** (named, not fixed). `useLanguageSelection` has one caller, `LocaleSwitcher`. The login page mounts it too, and no page there is registered. The profile page's language card does not call it. It writes `sys_user.locale` through the adapter, and `useSignedInUserLocale` (mounted once in `AppContent`) applies the column through the i18n `changeLanguage` on the next `sys_user` invalidation. That reaches the same `key={language}` remount without this menu. The profile page registers no edits with the seam, so there is nothing for it to ask on that path. Whether that remount drops a draft in another profile card was NOT MEASURED. The profile page's docstring also still says the globe menu does not write the column, which objectui#10059 changed.
- **The tab-close prompt after OK.** Because the promise is returned, the prompt stays quiet until the switch and its `sys_user.locale` write settle. The write runs after the remount, so a page edited and then closed inside that span would not be asked. Log out has the same shape. NOT MEASURED.
- The seam's own docstring lists the shell departures it guards and does not name the language menu. `chrome/unsavedEdits.ts` is outside this claim.

## Checklist

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)
